description: Analytical weighted-average-cost (WAC) estimate of current Lightyear holdings from an account statement. Bookings use Lightyear's FIFO cost basis, so this differs from the registered investment-account balance after any sell; never use it to verify or adjust the FIFO ledger (use compute_account_balance on the investment account for the booked balance).

file_path.description: AccountStatement path/base64 input. Provide exactly one of file_path or file_ref.
